answer: Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 3 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Because the plume reference is updated at each ridge checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the sparrow audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism as a result earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 76 aliases however many keys the operator holds. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
